script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.organization_id,
       j.job_status,
       j.cancel_requested,
       j.row_version,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       j.lease_owner,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.is_deleted,
       CAST(cw.id AS CHAR) AS claim_id,
       cw.result_ref AS claim_owner,
       (cw.id IS NOT NULL AND cw.started_at > n.t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS claim_live,
       CAST(cr.id AS CHAR) AS rclaim_id,
       cr.result_ref AS rclaim_owner,
       (cr.id IS NOT NULL AND cr.started_at > n.t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS rclaim_live,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_publish_step st
         WHERE st.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_pV3typnk.data.tenantId}}'
           AND st.job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
           AND st.is_deleted = 0
           AND st.step_name IN ('P1_GD_HEADER', 'P2_GD_STRUCTURE', 'P3_INVENTORY_APPLY', 'P6_PUBLICATION_BARRIER', 'P7A_OUTBOX_BLOCKED', 'P7B_GD_CREATED', 'P7B_SO_PROJECTION', 'P7C_OUTBOX_READY', 'P7D_JOB_COMMITTED')) AS steps_after_p0,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_operation op
         WHERE op.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_pV3typnk.data.tenantId}}'
           AND op.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_pV3typnk.data.organizationId}}'
           AND op.source_job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
           AND op.is_deleted = 0
           AND op.operation_status <> 'REJECTED') AS ops_open
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_pV3typnk.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_pV3typnk.data.organizationId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_pV3typnk.data.jobId}}
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step cw
    ON cw.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_pV3typnk.data.tenantId}}'
   AND cw.job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND cw.step_name = (CONCAT('W0_CLAIM_', j.row_version) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND cw.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step cr
    ON cr.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_pV3typnk.data.tenantId}}'
   AND cr.job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND cr.step_name = (CONCAT('R0_CLAIM_', j.row_version) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND cr.is_deleted = 0
